transcript.text: Here's how to defeat Emerus in RuneScape Dragon Wilds 1.0. As far as my build, I went with the
steel great sword, the weight full armor, which will be equivalent to the steel armor, using the enchantment for
air on the weapon for faster swings, your cloak of choice, and the strength amulet.
You do want to get your consumables on, wetstone if you're going melee. We got the attack potion, wild pie, and
pumpkin spice infusion. Make sure you guys have those if you are going melee specifically. If you want to
do mage, which I also think is viable, you just don't want to use fire damage. You don't want to have any poison damage
if you're going range uh because she is immune to those effects. But, starting off immediately, as soon as she lands,
there is a ground attack. So, just make sure you dodge for that. And I went in for the explosive melee.
And then you're just going to dodge, of course, when she's in the air.
And when she lands again, every time, there's going to be a ground attack that you need to dodge.
And then you're going in for the melee hits. It's easy to avoid the fire because if you're close up, obviously,
she can't hit you with the fire on those.
Uh when she does get into spectral form, you actually want to go into spectral form to stun.
So, don't do what I did there. As you can see, that you can't do any damage if she is in spectral form and you're not
in spectral form. So, keep in that until the next phase starts.
And then while you are in spectral form and there is that brief time that there is no combat, just take out the ads as
And ultimately, you're just repeating that until the end.
